canonical_data: agents, conversations, memory, skills, connections, and encrypted secrets in the control-plane PostgreSQL database
current_repo_note: Began as a credential vault for agents and was rebuilt as a team agent platform (v2); adoption signals mix both periods.
strengths: Credentials never reach the agent: a gateway intercepts outbound requests and injects them at request time, with per-agent grants and a policy that applies across the team
Deterministic human-in-the-loop approvals in chat for actions such as sending an email or deleting a ticket
The agent is a durable object with a sandbox, conversation, editable memory, skills, and a schedule, and the runner is outbound-only so it works behind NAT
weaknesses: Three ee directories and a separate enterprise license cover enterprise features, which need a subscription for production use
The README describes the harness interface as vendor-neutral, so the agent runtime inside the sandbox is a separate choice a reader must make
The repository was created in March 2026 and was rebuilt from a vault into a platform, so the current design has a short track record
why_it_matters: Applies credential isolation and approval gates to the multi-user problem that single-user agent runtimes leave open.
